from common import *
import math

def replay(scores,patience):
 best=-math.inf
 best_round=None
 for i,value in enumerate(scores,1):
  assert math.isfinite(value)
  if value>best:
   best=value
   best_round=i
  if i-best_round>=patience:
   return {'best_observed_round':best_round,'best_observed_score':best,'observed_stop_round':i,'right_censored':False}
 return {'best_observed_round':best_round,'best_observed_score':best,'observed_stop_round':None,'right_censored':True}

def main():
 save_source(__file__)
 state=read(PROGRESS)
 rows=[]
 for job in state['jobs']:
  if job['status']!='succeeded':continue
  check(job['evidence'])
  receipt=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{job["job_id"]}.json')
  es=receipt['early_stopping'][0]
  history=es['metric_history']
  ties=receipt['tie_diagnostics']
  assert len(history)==len(ties)==len(receipt['rounds'])
  assert [r['round'] for r in ties]==list(range(1,len(ties)+1))
  forward=replay(history,es['early_stopping_rounds'])
  reverse=replay([r['reverse_priority_score'] for r in ties],es['early_stopping_rounds'])
  assert forward['best_observed_round']==es['best_iteration']
  assert abs(forward['best_observed_score']-es['best_score'])<1e-12
  at_cap=len(history)==es['num_boost_round']
  assert forward['observed_stop_round']==len(history) or at_cap
  rows.append({'job_id':job['job_id'],'candidate':job['variant'],'seed':job['seed'],
   'receipt':job['evidence'],'observed_rounds':len(history),'selected_round':es['best_iteration'],
   'round_cap_reached':at_cap,'forward_replay':forward,'reverse_priority_replay':reverse,
   'reverse_best_changed_in_observed_prefix':reverse['best_observed_round']!=es['best_iteration'],
   'selected_boundary_ties':receipt['selected_boundary_ties']})
 out={'generated_at':time.time(),'status':'complete' if len(rows)==20 else 'partial',
  'successful_fit_count':len(rows),'new_fits':0,'rows':rows,
  'interpretation':'Replay applies the original strict-improvement patience rule to recorded objective sequences. Reversed priority only changes ordering among tied scores. A missing observed_stop_round is right-censoring, not an extrapolated completed alternative fit. No training settings or official selected models changed.',
  'reverse_changed_prefix_best_count':sum(r['reverse_best_changed_in_observed_prefix'] for r in rows),
  'reverse_unobserved_stop_count':sum(r['reverse_priority_replay']['right_censored'] for r in rows),
  'cap_count':sum(r['round_cap_reached'] for r in rows)}
 write(BASE/'docs/early-stopping-replay.json',out)
 print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ['status','successful_fit_count','reverse_changed_prefix_best_count','reverse_unobserved_stop_count','cap_count']},ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
